prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Waiting screen stage redesign with desktop preview: Redesign the waiting screen layout into a stage format showing active desktop setup status and visual desktop ready indicators. (why: Home target step drop-off is 81.3% with high mean wait times (2336s), and support reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive choice card selection flow: Transform pet selection into a rich choice cards grid highlighting desktop companion characteristics before adoption. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in onboarding (60.9%) and takes a median 89s / mean 1017s.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Story screen position lead reorder: Move the story screen to precede path selection, establishing emotional engagement before asking users to select an adoption path. (why: Choose path drops off at 76.2% conversion; introducing story narrative first increases user commitment.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Post-onboarding desktop launcher welcome screen: Add a dedicated post-setup desktop launcher confirmation screen explaining background tray operations. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8%, and support receives multiple tickets regarding controls and desktop behavior after setup.)
4: [home, hint] Desktop taskbar hint during waiting step: Add a descriptive hint box on the waiting screen reminding users to check their system tray or taskbar if the app minimizes. (why: Support logged 3 emails where pet did not show on desktop or app appeared not to open during setup.)
5: [finish, layout] Spotlight layout for home introduction: Switch home_intro layout to spotlight mode to focus user attention on finishing onboarding. (why: Finish step drop-off is 64.8% with long completion times (median 395s / mean 5815s).)
6: [home, notification] Desktop ready notification toggle on waiting screen: Enable desktop notification switch and progress display on the waiting screen while background assets load. (why: Mean wait time on waiting step is 2336s; users multitask and miss when the desktop pet is ready.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Path option clarity copy update: Clarify choose_path headline and body text to clearly differentiate preset adoption vs custom photo generation. (why: Choose path step takes mean 514s and drop-off is 76.2%, indicating hesitation between creation paths.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from funnel wait times and support tickets, but redesigns carry execution risk.
Targets the step with the highest drop-off rate (39.1%), though building a new flow requires high effort.
Reordering showed slight positive lift in earlier tests, but evidence for choose_path is limited to funnel metrics.
High support evidence, but previous finish new_screen test resulted in negative lift (-5.8%).
Low-cost hint directly addressing support tickets about pets missing in tray during setup.
Finish step has high drop-off and long completion times, though evidence is based only on funnel data.
Addresses long mean wait times (2336s) by allowing users to multitask during background loading.
Cheap text update addressing user hesitation (514s mean time) at choose_path.
